notes.title: Update 1.1 is out now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics!
The last few months without a doubt were full of hard work and resulted in major changes for CMS VR. Thanks to your suggestions we implemented a multitude of interesting features. Today we would like to roughly summarise all of the changes the game received throughout the last two months:

Sandbox mode - everyone likes some freedom! When using the sandbox mode, you can buy and fix any car that you want, regardless of its price. Wouldn’t it be great if we could also do this in real life?

Various controller setups were tweaked to match their individual button layouts and make navigating through the game more intuitive. Now all of the available headsets are supported and play out great!

The overall performance of the game received a massive boost. Not only did we manage to greatly shorten the loading times of the vehicles, we also smoothened the overall framerate and the warm reviews we received after those changes only prove that right now the game works really well!

When developing the game we made the decision not to make the smallest car parts physical as we thought working on them would become troublesome BUT after listening to your feedback we changed that, so now each and every part can be grabbed, picked up and mounted physically.

In order to make the gameplay more fluent we decided to add in a system responsible for switching the game modes automatically. This greatly minimized the need of constantly using the pie menu thus shortening the time needed to complete an ongoing job.

The tools also received a fair bit of attention. The welder, the grinder, the spring puller and the oil bin have all been revamped and now behave much more like in the real world!

Aside from the tools present during the release of the game, we also added some new ones, like the impact wrench or a bunch of ratchet wrenches. We also added in the possibility to freely spawn and despawn all of the parts present within the player's inventory.

Among the major changes, we also can’t forget about the numerous quality of life tweaks, such as adding in the possibility to sort your shopping list or adjust the player’s height if you feel like it.

Repairing cars is no piece of cake and you surely cannot learn how to do it within a single tutorial, so we decided that CMS VR should have two! The first one’s purpose is to make you familiar with moving around and interacting with the VR world. It recently received a lifting and based on the feedback it is now much more intuitive and helpful. The big tutorial that is teaching the basics of working on cars in CMS VR has also received a few changes, mostly consisting of the addition of minigames that will help you memorize the way things work.

Finally, here is the list of changes for today’s update:

- Keyboard’s colour changed (in the garage)
- Fixed… fixing parts on the workbench
- Fixed repairing and assembling shock / absorber
- Fixed error during loading saved game
- Fixed showing POI during the game
- Fixed update rim object materials
- Fixed change rust weight materials property when finish repair one par

notes.title: Update 1.09 is out now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics!

Throughout the last week we have been working on a few changes that should make getting started in CMS VR a little easier. The big tutorial received an indicator showing you how many points of interest you still can visit in order to learn each and every aspect of the game. Almost all of the points of interest now also allow you to immediately check out the mechanisms they feature - all of course done through your hands like in real life.

The welder has received a small tweak and will now emit blinding light, so that you are able to use it only when wearing the welding mask. Protect yourself at all times!

Thanks to your feedback we learned that many of you found it hard to finish the tutorial so we decided to add a final point of interest to the garage. It will show you explicitly what you need to do in order to proceed.
In case you find it hard to finish the tutorial, we want to remind you that all you need to do is pour new oil into the car and take it to the test track.

Apart from the above mentioned changes, the game also received some smaller tweaks, all of them listed further down below.

We want to thank you for all of the suggestions you have submitted throughout the latest days. As always, remember that if you are enjoying our game and what we are doing with it, then we would be thankful if you reviewed it on it’s Steam page. Each and every one of your reviews provides us with a huge boost of energy and motivation for further work!

notes.title: DEMO update!
notes.notes:
Hi Mechanics,

We have just published an update for the Demo version of Car Mechanic Simulator VR. The update contains numerous tweaks and enhancements that the full version of the game received throughout the latest weeks. If you want to, you can check out the demo right now as it is completely free. It offers almost all of the features included in the full version as well as a special garage in which you are able to repair a single vehicle.

What you will experience within the demo is only a foretaste of what Car Mechanic Simulator VR truly is, so feel free to check it out and share your thoughts on it. We would also like to kindly invite you to buy the full version of the game if you like the demo.

notes.title: Update 1.08 is out now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanics!

Considering the recent influx of new players and major changes in the game mechanics, we've decided to change the "first steps in VR" tutorial and the big familiarization one to show you all the possibilities of CMS VR. We still plan to expand the big tutorial to include the possibility to try out all the devices without having to dismantle the cars, but we still need some time. 

The small tutorial now includes instructions for a full car oil service, which we hope will help new players learn the basics of navigating our virtual world.

We've added more immersive features to the game itself - from now on, the computers in the office as well as those in the diagnostic lane can be activated with a button on the chassis, rather than a laser as before (for veterans, the laser option is still available)

The glasses available in the garage now automatically activate the "examine" mode - you do not have to launch it from the pie menu.

At your request, we have added a button to move ALL parts from the garage to the inventory. You no longer have to carry each part separately or bring them in the trolley to the zone.

Parts picked up with the left hand now show their condition on the watch. Previously this feature only worked on mounted parts, now it is available on removed parts.

The welder has received a new sound and the ability to repair parts that are removed from the car. The grinder can now also repair some parts.

The keyboard should be more visible, we've changed the colour scheme of the buttons and the lettering on them.

notes.title: Update 1.07 is LIVE out now!
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics,
We are very thankful for the warm reception of the latest patch and for the kind reviews you posted on our Steam page. We reached the 72% positive review mark and that alone gave us a huge chunk of motivation for further work.
This week we decided to focus on some of the devices without which working in a garage would not be possible.
You can now manually use the spring clamp in order to put together and take apart suspension arms.

The welder can now be used to repair rusty car bodies. Simply put it onto a car and press the trigger and the rust should come off easily. Car sheathing elements such as doors can also be derusted this way, but need to first be taken off of the car.
The repairing table now works the way it should, you can put any part you want on it and then use the hammer laying on it to fix the part.
Remember that when doing all of the above you are still limited by the skill tree perks related to part fixing and that some parts can be damaged beyond repair.

The cleaning toolkit can also be used by hand - grab a spray bottle and use it on the inside of the car.

All of the computers in the garage have been equipped with a power button so you no longer need to use the laser to turn them on.

The battery charger also received a revamp. You now no longer need to use the pie menu to make it work. Simply grab a battery and place it on the charger where the clamps are and the charging will start automatically. We also added a small indicator showing you the charging progress.
The custom user music radio station is back! Now you can listen to any songs you like in CMS VR!

We also enhanced the scrolling lists, which now should be bigger and more user-friendly.

The watch has received a new panel responsible for displaying your local time.

notes.title: CMS VR update 1.06 is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics!

The newest update has just arrived on Steam and we want to cordially invite you to check out what has been added to the game for yourselves.

We heard your response to the previous update and added a cart to the garage, which will allow you to carry multiple parts around. Now you won’t need to go shopping as often! :D

Now each and every item will produce a sound when hitting the floor - this should turn the immersiveness up a notch. We also added proper sounds to the window sprays - a thing we forgot to add last time.

When refilling the oil in an engine, the game will now display a window indicating the current oil level, which should help you be more accurate when pouring. Also the oil you spill on the ground will now leave oil stains on the ground!

We decided to add in a special warning, which will let you know if the number of parts present in your garage exceeds the preferable level and that the game might slow down should you continue to pile them up.

From now on you can also sit inside the cars present in the garage, car salon and other various locations.

Your Steam reviews are of great importance to us and give us an enormous energy boost, so if you like the game and the latest changes, we highly encourage you to write and post your review!

[b]Hello mechanics![/b]

This time we focused mainly on improving the game's loading times. Our inner testing showed that the average time required to load a car was reduced from up to 90 to as little as 2 seconds! We hope that this improvement will allow you to enjoy the game without having to wait for needlessly long loading screens.

notes.title: Car Mechanic Simulator VR - 1.03 update!
notes.notes:
Dear mechanics!

Last time we showed you what we were working on at the time. As our testing process is approaching an end, it’s high time we introduced you to our new system responsible for automatic assembly and disassembly game mode changing and also a system allowing you to disassemble parts that don’t have bolts on them by hand. Check them out and see for yourselves how they are working! We hope that the introduction of those systems will make the gameplay more enjoyable! Make sure to let us know how you like the changes!

Currently, our main goal is to make as many in-game activities as we can fully interactable, minimizing the use of the laser pointer. This update is the first of many updates to come, so make sure to check in frequently! Your suggestions and tips on what would make the game better are of great value to us, so make sure to keep them coming. If you would like to submit your feedback, be sure to join our discord channel, where we keep track of all of your messages and reply on a regular basis (https://discord.gg/46jXGSVdEE). Your engagement really keeps us going and points us in the way leading to Car Mechanic Simulator VR becoming the best game for virtual mechanics!

We want to inform those of you, who up to this point was not satisfied with the level of immersion provided by our game, that we are constantly working on new solutions and various enhancements and we highly encourage you to give our game another go. Truly a lot has changed!

Besides the aforementioned changes, we also implemented a wide range of smaller tweaks which you suggested. For example, the lighting was changed to make the engine chambers brighter and the shadows in overview mode were revamped. Now you will be able to better see which parts require your immediate attention.

Your Steam reviews are of great importance to us and give us an enormous energy boost, so if you like the game and the latest changes, we highly encourage you to write and post your review!

We will soon write to you again and present you with our plans for upcoming changes. See you soon!

- The GameFormatic developer team

notes.title: Car Mechanic Simulator VR - 1.02 update!
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanics!

We have an [b]update 1.02[/b] for you.

Over the last few days, we have improved several mechanics in the game. [b]The biggest change is that now all parts are physical and you can grab them[/b]. Brake discs, calipers, etc. have to be manually lifted after unscrewing. We have improved the position of the dipstick/oil dipstick on your hand - also you can see it better (more clear) and check the oil more accurately. Sheds and cars bought in are now correctly transferred to the garage - you will no longer lose money buying a car there. [b]Assembly of parts with several components is now possible![/b] From now on, fitting a radiator or calipers will not result in a mistake with a waste of money and parts. The watch on your wrist works as it should. Check the most important information on it now! The sale and purchasing of cars have been improved, now the window on the tablet is displayed correctly. The summary screen in the shed has been enlarged and can now be seen better. [b]Minor fixes added to improve the stability, smoothness, and performance of the game[/b]. So the game should run better (btw let us know!). We added a shopping list (on a tablet) so every time, you will know exactly what do you need to buy from the store. We improved (a lot!) HP Reverb G2 support, Windows Mixed Reality support, and Valve Index controllers support. Oh, last but not least... [b]we've added Sandbox mode![/b]

[b]Full list of the changes from 1.02 update[/b]:
- Changing the position of the oil dipstick
- Improvements to making shopping in the shed
- Interactive physical elements added in the whole car
- Assembling of elements with several components
- Reassembling elements with a screwdriver
- Watch 
- Selling and buying a car
- Enlarged summary screen in the shed
- Stability/performance improvements
- Tire changer fix
- Notes update
- Sandbox mode added
- Video and audio options enlarged
- Changed colour of prices in shops,
- Keyboard lock on the tablet (now you can't accidentally click on items behind the keyboard)
- Added text informing that 'no parts were found in the shop'

[b]PS If you like CMS VR, please write a review on Steam! <3 [/b]

notes.title: Car Mechanic Simulator VR - 1.01 update!
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics!

Today we introduce you to the first update (1.01) of the game.
It contains multiple adjustments, which we were able to implement thanks to your feedback. Some of the features were revamped to match your suggestions so as to make the game more enjoyable.
We are thankful for all of your comments and hope that thanks to you we will be able to make CMSVR fulfill all of your expectations. We highly encourage you to feel free to contact us on both steam and discord, where we will gladly discuss all of the game's features with you and hear your suggestions. We are waiting for you! Below you will find a summary of the latest changes.

- First and foremost we added the audio options to the tablet and lowered the initial volume of the music from 100% to 30%. If you want to find the options, simply press the designated button on the tablet, and work your way to the Audio Icon. The radio still has the ability to change the music if you feel like it.
- The bottles received proper glass breaking sounds.
- For HTC Vive Wand controller users, we changed the key bindings a little bit. From now on, the player’s rotation happens not when you touch the touchpad, but when you press it all the way. That should eliminate unintentional rotations caused by finger slips.
- Also, while going with the option of smooth movement, crouching now happens when you press the middle of the touchpad and not its bottom so now you won’t move back accidentally while trying to crouch.
- The main garage lighting was enhanced, the whole room should now feel more radiant.
- Before, the cars could sometimes repair some of their parts on their own when transitioning to different locations. This should no longer be a problem.
- The in game shop received a new ability to maximize and shrink its window if you happen to find it troublesome to navigate through it. The buttons responsible for performing these actions are located in the top left corner of the shop window.
- The computer mice were readjusted and should now have a more pleasant feel to them.
- The paint room should also no longer cause you any trouble, allowing you to paint your cars the way you want.
- The wheels! The tires should now always match their rims. We know it was a recurring issue among many of the players.
- The tablet should now always be grabbable when you are on the track scenes.

And that should be about it in terms of the bigger changes. A full list containing all of the minor tweaks is present below. We still encourage you to rate our game and comment on our ongoing efforts, because only thanks to you we will be able to make our game better! We want it to give you as much joy as possible and promise to give all that we have got to make it come true. We hope you will stay with us! Thank you and see you later!

All the changes from the 1.01 patch:
- Fixed Computer Mouse
- Fixed bug with wheels
- Fixed toolboxes drawers
- Fixed Dyno Doors
- Fixed paintshop doors and DiagPath doors
- Changed background image in the shop
- Fixed walls and lights in the Auction room
- Updated physical wheel start rotation
- Changed controller bindings in HTC VIVE
- Improved lighting in the Main garage
- Changed sounds volume
- Fixed broken glass volume
- Added Audio settings to the tablet
- Added icons for AudioSettings and VideoSettings 
- Fixed localization VR Settings text
- Fixed VR Mouse movement
- Fixed Level of Details in some objects
- Fixed paintroom
- Added SteamVR controller config info
- Fixed German translations
- Shop scale option
- Tablet UI touch support is disabled now

notes.title: Car Mechanic Simulator VR - release update
notes.notes:
Dear Mechanics,

We will be updating the game frequently over the next few days. After the release, we got a lot of great and useful ideas about how to improve the gameplay and what to add to the game. All the time we will be fixing bugs and polishing the game's features.

Right now we want to mainly focus on:
[list]
[*] Solving tutorial problems - some of you suggested developing it, we are collecting all ideas and you can write under this post what needs to be clarified. CMS is a huge game that contains a lot of mechanics, so the first contact with it can be difficult.[/list][list]
[*] We want the game to work 'out of the box' so if you have any problems with goggles or controllers feel free to let us know. We are aware of the problem with the HP Reverb G2 and we are working to resolve it. It should be fixed in the next update. We are asking you all for any suggestions which may improve the controls in the game.[/list][list]
[*] Some of you write about hardcore mode - we will try to do our best, but once again we remind you that this is a port of the flat version, many things need to be simplified and due to the complexity of some actions, it will cost us a lot of time to meet all your requirements.[/list][list]
[*] Sandbox mode - we are still working on it and we will inform all fans of free play when it will be implemented in our game.[/list][list]
[*] Codes - yes we have changed them. 
Here they are:
[strike]cmsVRpromo, 
cmsVRstage1, 
cmsVRstage2, 
cmsVRstage3[/strike].[/list][list]
[*] Last but not least, the tools - in the coming days we will be posting short instructional videos on how to operate (repair, renovate, paint, move, etc.) the cars in the game using tools.
[/list]Sorry for any inconvenience and thank you for your support!
GameFormatic Team
